studyName: Sampling expedition from which data were collected, generated, etc.
Sample Number: continuous numberng sequence for each sample
Species: a string representing the species of an organism
Region: Nominal region of Palmer LTER sampling grid
Island: Island near Palmer Station where samples were collected
Individual ID: A unique ID for each individual in dataset
Clutch Completion: Was the study nest observed with a full clutch, i.e., 2 eggs
Date Egg: Date study nest observed with 1 egg (sampled)
Culmen Length (mm): length of the dorsal ridge of a bird's bill
Culmen Depth (mm): depth of the dorsal ridge of a bird's bill
Sex: code for the sex of an animal
Delta 15 N (o/oo): a measure of the ratio of stable isotopes 15N:14N
Delta 13 C (o/oo): a measure of the ratio of stable isotopes 13C:12C
Comments: Text field to provide additional relevant information for data
